task: Add integration tests for pagination behavior on the Data Sources page and the User/Project Settings tables under Integrations, following the existing renderPage()/mockAPI() pattern, with no production code changes.

key_reasoning.reason: Three distinct page-level components (DataSourcesPage, UserSettings, ProjectSettings) must be covered, each wired to a different Valtio store (dataSourceStore, userSettingsStore, projectSettingsStore); the ticket also invites an optional new cross-cutting 'assert a Table paginates' helper that would need to abstract over all three data-fetch paths plus the ProjectSettings admin-gated tab-switch precondition.

Acceptance criteria are detailed and unambiguous, but the task is explicitly 'similar to the prior EPMCDME-13479 task but different' in several load-bearing ways (DECIMAL_PAGINATION_OPTIONS vs DEFAULT_PAGINATION_OPTIONS, no router URL-sync for these pages, new per-page-dropdown interaction, admin-gated ProjectSettings tab click) — a red flag that bumped this from S to M.

Core pagination mechanics (DOM-absence convention, nested envelope, renderPage()/mockAPI() harness) are already proven by the prior task, but the 'per-page change' AC requires genuinely new end-to-end interaction code (no existing test drives the PrimeReact per-page <Select> via selectDropdownOption), and DataSourcesPage has a background 5s refetch timer plus no global fetch-mock defaults for 6 relevant endpoints, raising flakiness/setup risk.

red_flags_applied: Requirements Clarity bumped from S to M: task is explicitly framed as 'similar to prior task (EPMCDME-13479) but different' in pagination option constants, URL-sync behavior, per-page interaction, and admin-gated tab-switch setup
